title: Douzone Bizon backup-service breach: Genesis Lab and Incheon Airport Facilities Management added to affected clients, Boannews reports
date_note: Boannews' 23 November update is the first source; the page gives no earlier day for the two companies' disclosures.
geo_basis: country: Douzone's headquarters city is not stated in the pages read
sector: Business software and its client companies
summary: Boannews says Genesis Lab and Incheon Airport Facilities Management are newly listed among Douzone Bizon clients. Genesis Lab says Douzone told it that its data backup service (APO) server was accessed without authorisation and stored data appears to have been taken, possibly including employees' names, resident registration numbers, account numbers and addresses. The airport company says the cause was also the backup service and the data items are still being investigated.
plain: Two more companies say Douzone Bizon's backup service was breached and their data may have been taken. Genesis Lab's staff records may be affected; the airport company is still checking.
exec: Boannews reports that client companies are still being added to the Douzone backup-service breach, many with data items under investigation.
action: Genesis Lab says it is reviewing the data held by its contractor and how it is stored and disposed of; no further advice is given in the pages read.

validation.note: The two new clients' disclosures come only from Boannews; MTN (26 Oct) was read for the background (Douzone's own notice about an Ahsay backup-software flaw) and does not mention these two companies.
